Hi everyone,

I recently created a draped dress called “VIREXIA”, inspired by the idea of a modern virtual divinity.

I’ve uploaded a short animation highlighting the garment’s silhouette, texture, and the presence of my virtual muse, Genevieve.

Would love to share it here:

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lCbgUcp32xc?start=0

For better viewing, I recommend watching in high quality.

Any feedback is welcome :)

title: 3d window result not showing as in 2d window
content:
![55443a13e38a48c1869af51f667e355a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/0e6dbb47756144ab9608f57e8da93358/images/55443a13e38a48c1869af51f667e355aimage.png)![324381d8b43d4b9e94f7efb2d8f0323a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/0e6dbb47756144ab9608f57e8da93358/images/324381d8b43d4b9e94f7efb2d8f0323aimage.png)Hello Everyone,

can anyone suggest why 3d window result not showing as in 2d window.

Regards,

Nk

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Neeraj, can you check the Z-Offset of your topstitches? If you want the red to display on top of the white stitching, the value should be higher. (This is my best guess now. In the future, can you please point to the difference you are seeing and what elements are affected? Thank you.)
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to seek community assistance in troubleshooting why the 3D window display is not rendering results as expected compared to the 2D window in a software application.
